scripts.sync-types: mkdir -p apps/web/src/types apps/api/src/types apps/mobile/types && cp packages/shared/types/index.ts apps/web/src/types/shared.ts && cp packages/shared/types/index.ts apps/api/src/types/shared.ts && cp packages/shared/types/index.ts apps/mobile/types/shared.ts
scripts.dev: npm run sync-types && concurrently "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run sync-types && npm run start --prefix apps/mobile
scripts.build: npm run sync-types && npm run build --prefix apps/web && npm run build --prefix apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run sync-types && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run sync-types && npm run build --prefix apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/web && npm run lint --prefix apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/api
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/web && npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/mobile
scripts.e2e:install: npm install --prefix e2e && npx --prefix e2e playwright install --with-deps chromium
scripts.e2e:dev: npm run sync-types && MONGO_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017/rentos_e2e JWT_SECRET=e2e-test-secret PAYMENTS_PROVIDER_MODE=simulated concurrently "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
